The '''{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}''' is used to grow [[hops]] and [[grapes]].  How quickly things grow, the yield, and their quality is highly dependent on the fertilizers you use, any active [[sermon]]s, and your chosen [[perks]].  For more information see the page on [[farming]].
